findings.title: Resolve deletes valid links and returns expired ones (inverted condition)
findings.description: Resolve checks `time.Now().Before(l.ExpiresAt)` and deletes/returns ErrNotFound. That is the non-expired case. Valid links are deleted on first resolve and expired links are returned with Hits++.

findings.title: NewStore leaves quota nil so Create panics on write
findings.description: NewStore initializes `links` but not `quota`. Create does `s.quota[owner]++` which panics with assignment to nil map on the first link.

findings.title: RequireAdmin condition is always true so no one passes
findings.description: Uses `s.Role != "admin" || s.Role != "owner"` which is true for every string (a value cannot be both). Even admins are rejected.

findings.title: BearerToken panics on missing or malformed Authorization header
findings.description: Splits header and unconditionally returns parts[1] without checking length. Empty or single-token header causes index-out-of-range panic, crashing the handler.

findings.title: Verify never checks expiry so expired tokens remain valid
findings.description: Verify iterates sessions and returns match without comparing ExpiresAt to Now. Expired sessions never become unknown.

findings.title: stats panics on divide-by-zero when store is empty
findings.description: Computes `hits / int64(len(links))` without guarding len==0. With no links this is a runtime panic.

findings.title: Page off-by-one causes out-of-bounds slice panic
findings.description: When end > len, sets `end = len(all)+1` then slices all[offset:end] which is past the slice capacity and panics.

findings.title: Validate always returns nil so invalid config is never rejected
findings.description: Collects problems and logs but unconditionally returns nil. Bad port/timeout/cache size passes startup.

findings.title: Metrics.AddResolved has value receiver so increment is lost
findings.description: Defined as `func (m Metrics) AddResolved()` — increments a copy. Resolved counter never advances; Snapshot always sees 0.

findings.title: WarmCache calls wg.Add inside goroutine causing race and missed Wait
findings.description: wg.Add(1) is inside the goroutine after `go` starts. Wait can return before Add, and concurrent Add/Wait is a race.

findings.title: mustHead returns nil on error causing client.Do(nil) panic
findings.description: On NewRequest error it logs and returns nil. Callers pass that nil to client.Do which panics (nil dereference).

findings.title: LINKD_CACHE_TTL_MS multiplied by seconds not milliseconds
findings.description: Comment says milliseconds but code does `time.Duration(n) * time.Second`. A value of 1000 becomes 1000s instead of 1s.

findings.title: Cache.Delete leaks lock on early return causing deadlock
findings.description: Locks, then if entry not found does bare `return` without Unlock. Any delete of missing key permanently holds the mutex.

findings.title: SuccessRate integer division always yields 0 unless 100%
findings.description: Computes `used / len(s.links) * 100` — integer division truncates to 0 when used < total. Only full usage reports correctly.
